title: Defining the teeing area
question: When starting a hole, where must the ball be placed for your first shot from the teeing area?

choices.text: Anywhere within 2 club-lengths from the tee markers, even if your feet are outside.
Directly on the line joining the two tee markers.
Completely inside the teeing area, which is defined by the tee markers and up to two club-lengths behind them.
Anywhere on the teeing ground as long as your stance is inside it.

explanation: The ball must be entirely inside the teeing area for your first shot, although your stance can be outside the area.
imagePrompt: A teenage boy is about to hit a tee shot, with the ball placed completely within the area marked by two visible tee markers. His feet are placed just outside the teeing area.
imageAlt: Teen boy preparing to tee off with ball correctly inside the space between yellow tee markers.

issues: Feet placement very close to line, but outside the teeing area as required.
Everything else matches the prompt well: girl, correct ethnicity and light skin tone, grey top, navy trousers, realistic driver, plausible posture, single ball, visible tee markers.
imageVerification.repairPrompt: Move the girl's feet slightly further outside the teeing area to make their position more visually unambiguous. Ensure all other prompt details remain unchanged.
